structure: A JSON backlog (backlog.json, corpus dr1u, run_id EUDPA-328-DR1U, target live-animals-frontend) with top-level keys corpus, increments, run_id, target. increments is an array of 161 rows (inc-NNN) with fields id, status, title, finding, decision, notes, openQuestions, failure_reason, gate, band, citations, evidence and others. Status counts: done 118, blocked 34, deferred 3, dropped 5, rejected 1. Scope read: the 43 non-done rows (blocked, deferred, dropped, rejected) with the reason held in each decision field (inc-043 also in notes); inc-161, the only done row with a decision field (a ruling); and the done rows whose notes or openQuestions record a RULING or a choice departing from the prototype (inc-003, inc-004, inc-006, inc-007, inc-033, inc-067, inc-079, inc-087, inc-091, inc-118, inc-122, inc-137, inc-138, inc-146, inc-147, inc-150, inc-153). Left out: the rest of the 118 done rows, the finding, evidence and citations fields, and inc-136 (an open refactor ticket, not a departure from the prototype). Rulings are by Sam (2026-08-21 descopes, rejections) and Rhys (2026-08-28 dashboard block, 2026-09-04 address block and disputed-band deferral, 2026-09-07 MDM block). The decision field is an object with ruling, note and ruledAt. Open questions are recorded as gap claims where the source asks for a decision it does not make.
